tei:div.tei:p: To God, who is blessed, they offer pleasant songs, to the King, the living eternal God, they intone songs of praise and let words of praise be heard. For He alone achieves mighty deeds, creates new things, dominates wars, sows kindnesses, lets salvation spring forth, creates remedies, He is awe-inspiring in deeds of renown, Lord of wonders, who daily in His goodness constantly renews the work of creation. As it says: To the Creator of the great lights, His mercy endures for ever.
